messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT OPEN — Elevated 5xx rate observed for requests routed to dedicated US-WEST capacity affecting a subset of enterprise tenants. Severity: P1. Pager: @aaron.sre. Status page draft: https://status.redwood.com/incident/6188889999

aar oncall: taking this. seeing 20–30% 502/504s from gateway -> dedicated-proxy-usw2. Investigating.

maya.eng: on it. grabbing proxy logs and pool health. initial glance shows TCP resets to some pool nodes.

maya.eng: ```[2026-03-17T17:09:58Z] proxy=dedicated-usw2 error="dial tcp 10.12.3.45:443: connection reset by peer"
[2026-03-17T17:10:01Z] proxy=dedicated-usw2 upstream=10.12.3.45 returned=503
```

linda.ops: Autoscaler didn't add nodes; control plane shows pool 'dedicated-usw2-pool-b' flagged draining by job 9876. That job was scheduled earlier — I'm checking why prod was targeted.

aaron.sre: rolling an emergency rollback of management job 9876 from pool 'dedicated-usw2-pool-b'. Running: `/runbook rollback-pool 9876`. ETA ~2m. Will update.

deploy-bot: rollback started by @aaron.sre — job 9876 rollback in progress (job-id: rb-9876).

priya.cs: Heads up — Tessera is on the affected tenant list and has opened a support ticket complaining of timeouts. We need a tailored customer blurb and owner for outreach.

tom.sales: I'll own Tessera outreach with @priya.cs. Put the draft in thread when ready.

sarah.support: Other affected accounts surfaced in tickets: NovumPay, Helix Systems. Quick contact list I pulled: Tessera (ops@tessera.com, eng: Carla T.), NovumPay (ops@novumpay.com), Helix (enterprise@helixsys.com). Adding to thread.

aaron.sre: rollback finished. Error rate dropping to baseline. p95 latency back to expected. Monitoring for stabilization window (30m).

maya.eng: root cause initial: a scheduled maintenance job targeted production pool via label mismatch in scheduler. Pushed a fix to scheduler to add stricter label filtering. PR: https://github.com/redwood/scheduler/pull/4321

priya.cs: Draft customer blurb for Tessera:
"Hi Carla — we observed increased errors and timeouts for requests routed to your dedicated US-WEST capacity between 17:09–17:15 UTC. Our engineers rolled back a maintenance change and service has been restored. There was no data exposure. We will send a post-incident summary within 48 hours. Contact: priya.cs@redwood.com."

tom.sales: small edit: include ETA for postmortem (48 hours) and a direct escalation contact line. Looks good — I'll send.

aaron.sre: Internal status page suggested text: "Degraded performance for dedicated US-WEST capacity affected some enterprise tenants 17:09–17:15 UTC. Services restored after rollback. Postmortem ETA: 48 hours." Recommend setting status to "degraded" and linking incident.

linda.ops: Updated https://status.redwood.com with the degraded notice and incident link. Pinned message in #incidents.

incident-bot: STATUS PAGE UPDATED — https://status.redwood.com/incident/6188889999

sarah.support: I've queued tailored email drafts in Helpdesk for Tessera, NovumPay, Helix under tag incident-6188889999. @tom.sales please review Tessera copy before send.

tom.sales: Reviewed and sent to Tessera (external copy):
"Hi Carla — brief: From 17:09–17:15 UTC your traffic to dedicated-us-west showed elevated errors. We rolled back a maintenance job; traffic is restored. No data impact. Next steps: postmortem in 48h. Contact: priya.cs@redwood.com. — Tom"

carla.tessera (customer, captured via support): "Thanks for the quick fix. Please keep us posted with root cause and permanent mitigation."

aaron.sre: Action summary: rollback performed; scheduler label-filter fix merged (PR 4321); monitoring window started; postmortem owner: @maya.eng; outreach by @priya.cs and @tom.sales.

maya.eng: Postmortem scope — why the maintenance job matched prod pool (label evaluation), how to harden scheduler, and add unit/regression tests for label scoping. Target postmortem draft: 48 hours.

priya.cs: I'll prepare tailored postmortem blurbs to meet SLAs for each affected account.

linda.ops: We'll mark incident resolved after 30m stable window. If no regression, final resolve message and link to postmortem when available.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — monitoring window passed. Root cause: scheduler label mismatch caused a maintenance job to target production pool. Postmortem ETA: 48 hours. Status link: https://status.redwood.com/incident/6188889999/postmortem
